documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a satisfying Q2 performance driven by healthy same-store sales growth, robust festive demand, and strong revenue traction from the newly launched regional brand ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai. Consolidated revenue for the quarter was INR 10,323 crores, while consolidated adjusted revenue came in at INR 9,943 crores. Management expressed high confidence in beating targeted revenue growth and maintained expectations for stable PBT margins and continued volume growth into H2. Additionally, the company is debt-free on non-GML debt and plans to launch four more ATM showrooms over the course of the financial year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue growth for the year should be a minimum of 25%.
guidance.quote: And with the store number which is increasing and the stores which we have opened in the last financial year, the revenue growth should be a minimum of 25%, which we have always said that.

guidance.claim: The company expects to complete non-GML debt repayment by the end of September.
guidance.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its target of opening 84 Kalyan showrooms in India and 50 showrooms for Candere for the financial year.
guidance.quote: Yes. No change in target. So last year also has been like this only. So no change in target. Usually, H2 is heavier than H1 in terms of store expansion and there is no change in target of number of showrooms in Kalyan and Candere.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of Q2 due to healthy same-store sales growth across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter on the back of very healthy same-store sales growth across most of the key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of Q1 except for one month of Adhik-Maas which slowed wedding-related demand in certain regions.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter, except for 1 month of. Adhik-Maas. During which wedding-related demand slowed down in certain parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: The ongoing quarter started off very well despite volatility in gold prices, and management is upbeat about the upcoming festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: And now talking about the ongoing quarter. The quarter has started off very well despite the volatility in gold prices. We are upbeat about the upcoming festive and wedding season and are fully geared up with fresh collections and campaigns.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand on the ground is strong and continues like Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. The demand on ground is strong. It continues like Q1.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch the next 4 showrooms of the regional brand ATM over the course of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: There are no immediate plans to launch ATM in a new state beyond Tamil Nadu.
capex_expansion.quote: Now coming to the cash flow utilization, no more immediate plans to launch ATM in a new state. We will continue only in Tamil Nadu because it has to shape up in one state, and which will at least take a couple of years.

capex_expansion.claim: The first showroom of the new regional brand Akshaya Thanga Maligai (ATM) will be launched on August 21st in Chennai, followed by four more showrooms in the coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The first showroom will be launched on 21st August in Chennai and shall be followed by another four showrooms in the next coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion of ATM will predominantly be through the asset-light FOCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, the expansion of ATM will also predominantly be FOCO, asset-light.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that PBT margins were very stable in Q2 when excluding one-off customs duty and previous year silver and platinum gains.
margins_costs.quote: So PBT margins, if you look at in Q2, it is very stable, wherein if you negate the -- of course, the onetime benefit of the customs duty and if you also negate the silver and platinum gains, which was there in the previous year quarter, Q2, you negate both that, the margins are stable.

margins_costs.claim: The share of recycled gold as a percentage of revenue increased to over 46% during Q1 FY2027.
margins_costs.quote: The initiative was well received by our customers, helping us to increase the share of recycled gold as a percentage of revenue to over 46% during Q1 FY 2027.

margins_costs.claim: For the month of June, the share of recycled gold exceeded 55%, and the company aims to maintain it between 55% and 60% going forward.
margins_costs.quote: For the month of June, the share of recycled gold was in excess of 55%, and our efforts will be to maintain the share in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.

margins_costs.claim: Old gold exchange is margin dilutive by around 0.2% to 0.3%.
margins_costs.quote: And you know that exchange itself is margin dilutive by around 0.2% -0.3%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is now debt-free on non-GML debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it is debt-free non-GML now, as you mentioned, and 50% of the collateral is already out of which we have sold one land parcel of INR86 crores, INR87 crores, and INR16 crores to be done on the ongoing quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow will predominantly be utilized to strengthen existing showrooms requiring more inventory to drive same-store sales growth.
capital_allocation.quote: But yes, the cash flow, predominantly, we want to utilize to strengthen our existing showrooms where certain showrooms need more inventory to drive more SSGs.

capital_allocation.claim: Agreements have been signed for two separate parcels of non-core real estate assets with an aggregate consideration of around INR102 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We have signed the agreement with potential buyers for 2 separate parcels of land with an aggregate consideration amount to around INR102 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp rise in international oil prices and resulting forex pressure led to the launch of the Shine with India gold recirculation campaign.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sharp rise in international oil prices and the resultant pressure on forex led us to launch our "Shine with India" gold recirculation campaign.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch four more ATM showrooms during the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to maintain the share of recycled gold in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.
management_commitments.quote: For the month of June, the share of recycled gold was in excess of 55%, and our efforts will be to maintain the share in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.

management_commitments.claim: The sale process for non-core real estate assets and receipt of consideration are expected to conclude before the end of the ongoing quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to conclude the sale process and receive consideration before the end of the ongoing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Non-GML debt repayment is on track to be completed by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
